description: Intentional differences between ProwlerAdditionsPolicy and upstream Prowler's permissions/prowler-additions-policy.json. Checked by scripts/check_prowler_permissions.py; every entry needs a reason and is reported as stale once it is no longer needed.

exceptions.reason: Upstream grants this on Resource '*'. The templates scope it to the Prowler Security Hub product ARN with a securityhub:TargetAccount condition for the deploying account.
